name: Hunan Silver Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hunan Silver Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of high-purity silver and silver deep-processing products in China and internationally. The company offers high-purity silver and silver products, high-purity silver nitrate, electrolytic lead, gold, lead concentrate, zinc concentrate, and sulfur concentrate. It is also involved in the mining, beneficiation, smelting, and trading of ferrous and non-ferrous metals. The company was formerly known as Chenzhou City Jingui Silver Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hunan Silver Co.,Ltd. in April 2024.
